framework: MLPerf Storage v2.0 reference (storage.git tag v2.0)
storage_backend: Curvine v0.2.0 (commit 77320b86) FUSE 3 with AWS S3 UFS
description: This implementation uses the MLCommons Storage v2.0 reference code with Curvine v0.2.0 (commit 77320b86) mounted through the Curvine FUSE 3 client; OpenDAL-S3 is used as the underlying file system. System config: 2 clients, 2 storage nodes, 32 simulated H100 accelerators. In this round the Curvine worker service was limited to 16 vCPU / 123 GiB per worker node.
run_command: mlpstorage training run --hosts 10.157.230.110,10.157.228.31 --num-client-hosts 2 --client-host-memory-in-gb 100 --num-accelerators 32 --accelerator-type h100 --model resnet50 --data-dir /curvine-fuse/resnet50_7485_999GB/resnet50 --results-dir /home/ec2-user/mlps_results --param dataset.num_files_train=7485 --param reader.read_threads=1 --oversubscribe
